mentions.name: Meldhive
mentions.description: Meldhive helps aspiring founders validate demand for their ideas by surfacing what their target market is already saying about the problem space across Reddit, X, TikTok and more, then structuring it into a data-backed report. It also highlights the gap between the language founders use and the words their customers actually use. It is free and in early access.
mentions.problem: Founders struggle to validate whether market needs are real, and they write in their own language while their customers use entirely different words.
mentions.audience: People who want to start something but don't know how to validate whether the needs out there are true.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building Meldhive for people who wanna start but don't know how to validate if the needs out there were true.  It finds what your market is already saying about your problem space, across Reddit, X, TikTok and more. Structures it into a report way with data.
